title: Fuel Rail Pressure Too Low
fullDescription: Yanmar 4TNV/4TNE/3TNV common rail engines used in compact tractors, skid steers, and gensets. Low rail pressure usually plugged filter or air leak.

fixSteps.title: Inspect for air leaks
fixSteps.instruction: Especially banjo fittings on filter base.

faq.a: Same engine family, suction water leaks more common.

title: Turbocharger Underboost
fullDescription: Yanmar turbocharged engines on heavier tractor/genset use suffer typical boost faults from charge air leaks and worn turbo bearings.

faq.a: Marine Yanmar has wastegated turbos with similar fault profile.

title: Crankshaft Position Sensor Circuit
fullDescription: Hot stall or no-start. Sensor inexpensive and front-mounted on most Yanmar engines.

faq.a: Hot stalling is the classic symptom.

title: Coolant Temperature Sensor Low Voltage
fullDescription: Failed ECT sensor causes wrong fueling and possibly hard cold start.

fixSteps.title: Compare to ambient at cold key-on
fixSteps.instruction: Should match outside temp within a few degrees.

faq.a: Yes, cold-start enrichment relies on ECT.

title: Sensor Reference Voltage B Open
fullDescription: Multiple sensors share 5V reference. An open or shorted sensor pulls reference down. Disconnect sensors one at a time to isolate.

fixSteps.title: List all simultaneous codes
fixSteps.instruction: All sensors on same ref will fault.

fixSteps.title: Disconnect sensors sequentially
fixSteps.instruction: When 5V returns, last disconnected is bad.

fixSteps.title: Replace failed sensor
fixSteps.instruction: MAP or rail pressure usual culprits.

faq.a: Rarely - almost always a sensor short.

title: Fuel Rail Pressure Sensor High Voltage
shortDescription: Rail pressure sensor signal too high.
fullDescription: Failed rail pressure sensor on 4TNV common rail engines. Replacement is straightforward.

fixSteps.title: Replace rail pressure sensor
fixSteps.instruction: On end of common rail. Clean before installing.

faq.a: No, copper crush washer must be new.

title: ECU Internal Performance Failure
fullDescription: Common after pressure-washing or salt exposure on marine/agricultural Yanmars. Check grounds and connectors first.

fixSteps.title: Inspect ECU connectors
fixSteps.instruction: Dielectric grease pins to prevent moisture.

faq.a: Coat connectors with dielectric grease and replace seals annually.

title: EGR Throttle Position Performance
shortDescription: EGR throttle valve not at expected position.
fullDescription: Yanmar Tier 4 engines use a throttle valve to support EGR flow. Carbon binding and stuck butterflies are common.

title: DPF Regeneration Required
fullDescription: Yanmar Tier 4 Final engines monitor DPF soot. P3000 prompts a parked regen.
whenToCallPro: Only if regen will not start.

faq.a: Yes - leads to higher fault levels and potential filter damage.

title: Cooling Fan Control Circuit
fullDescription: Some Yanmar industrial/genset variants use an electric or PWM-clutched fan. P0480 indicates control fault.

faq.a: Only PWM-clutch variants set this code.
